name: war-phase-scale-dust-bundle
about: v206 (Lane K): the destroyed-this-turn attribute tracking. 26RBS02-X05 (When Summoned) destroys one of your Spirits with a When Destroyed effect, then sends a core from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve; its LV2 End Step draws only after your own effect destroyed one of your Purple Spirits this turn. 26RBS02-076 deploys into MILL 2 only while your Trash holds no EX Symbol, and its LV2 End Step targets an opposing exhausted Spirit only after your own effect destroyed a Spirit with a When Destroyed effect. 26RSD08-002 (When Summoned) needs an exhausted Yellow Rise Spirit to return a Sword Eye Magic from the Trash, and its LV2 sends a Reserve core to the Life at two or less.
